title: Losing Your Body, Losing Your Self
coreMove: Trauma can make numbness feel normal, but agency returns only when safe body signals become readable enough to name needs, limits, pleasure, and danger.

exampleSpecs.audience: clinicians and helpers tempted to treat self-harm as only behavior control
exampleSpecs.stakes: Skin-picking may be the only reliable sensation available when ordinary touch has gone offline.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Shift from stopping the visible compulsion to testing whether the body can register safe touch.

exampleSpecs.audience: medical staff deciding whether numbness is central or secondary
exampleSpecs.stakes: Brain evidence can protect body disconnection from being dismissed as vague distress.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Use the imaging finding to keep sensory self-awareness in the center of care.

exampleSpecs.audience: helpers working with people who cannot name feelings
exampleSpecs.stakes: Missing emotion words can reflect a broken bridge between body signals and language.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Turn blank feeling boxes into a bodily-signal inquiry rather than a character judgment.

exampleSpecs.audience: survivors and supporters interpreting detached calm after threat
exampleSpecs.stakes: Detachment can reduce overwhelm while also making the body and reality feel distant.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Recognize depersonalization as protection with a cost, not proof that the event did no harm.

exampleSpecs.audience: facilitators pacing trauma recovery without forcing disclosure
exampleSpecs.stakes: Starting with safe sensation can restore choice before a full trauma narrative is ready.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Begin with a tolerable body signal so the person can regain agency without premature storytelling.

exampleSpecs.audience: care teams deciding how much body awareness work belongs in treatment
exampleSpecs.stakes: A care plan that skips sensory self-awareness may miss the very system trauma weakened.
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Let the research change the agenda before the team defaults to story-only treatment.
